title: Replace unexplained numbers
summary: A named constant explains why a special value appears. It also gives the rule one clear place to change.
introduction: A named constant explains why a special value appears. It also gives the rule one clear place to change. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.title: Replace unexplained numbers

blocks.text: The result is true. The name explains why 3 is used in the rule.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Change the limit to 4 and test count 3.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not name every obvious arithmetic value; name values whose meaning needs explaining.
For more detail later, use this [Clean Code further reading](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/MDN/Writing_guidelines/Code_style_guide/JavaScript).
